docs.title: Iska
docs.text:
First Warden

Role: Ruler · Age: Adult

Quick, sure and hard to rattle; she reads people the way she reads the tide and rarely wastes a word.

The other sea wardens chose her as First Warden because no pilot alive knows the inlet better. Every summer she skippers Goa Harbour's boat in the race around Veligor, and she has lost to Bain Harbour's crew by a single length more times than she likes to admit.

Relationships:

  • Dunmor: husband
  • Arlo: son
  • Ysmay: mother
  • Varro: mentor
  • Nessa: friendly rival
  • Halvard: clerk
  • Kor: hopeful crewman
  • Ruan: trusted captain
  • Tamsin: boatwright
  • Jory: crewman
  • Quenna: rival racer and friend

docs.title: Varro
docs.text:
Eldest of the Sea Wardens

Role: Council · Age: Elder

Gruff, patient and slow to praise; he still walks the quay at dawn to watch the water before anyone else is up.

Varro taught Iska to pilot when she was barely tall enough to see over a gunwale. His knees no longer let him take ships through the gap, but the wardens still bring him every hard question about the tides.

Relationships:

  • Iska: pupil
  • Nessa: former pupil
  • Arlo: eager shadow
  • Ysmay: old friend
  • Ailsa: old colleague

docs.title: Nessa
docs.text:
Sea Warden

Role: Council · Age: Adult

Sharp-tongued, funny and fiercely competitive; she argues every point at the Wardens' table and then buys the first round.

Nessa was the other name spoken when the wardens chose their First Warden, and she backed Iska herself in the end. She wants the wardens to train more young pilots before the rougher seas of recent years catch them short-handed.

Relationships:

  • Iska: friend and fellow warden
  • Varro: old teacher

docs.title: Ailsa
docs.text:
Keeper of the Tide Book

Role: Scholar · Age: Elder

Precise, dry and quietly delighted by patterns; she can recite a tide from forty years ago.

Ailsa keeps the great Tide Book, where the wardens have written down every tide since the first camp on the shore. Lately the new pages do not match the old ones as well as they should, and she is trying to work out why before she says so out loud.

Relationships:

  • Varro: old colleague
  • Halvard: friend

docs.title: Halvard
docs.text:
Clerk of the Wardens' House

Role: Official · Age: Adult

Fussy, orderly and kind underneath; he cannot leave a crooked ledger alone.

Halvard records every ship that comes through the gap and every pilot who brings it in. He came from a farming valley inland and still gets seasick standing on the quay.

Relationships:

  • Iska: employer
  • Ailsa: friend

docs.title: Kor
docs.text:
Sea Warden

Role: Worker · Age: Young

Cheerful and a little reckless; he whistles while he pilots and swears the tide likes him.

Kor became a full warden only last spring and already takes more ships through the gap than anyone. He secretly hopes Iska will pick him for the race crew this summer.

Relationships:

  • Corrie: apprentice
  • Iska: First Warden

docs.title: Corrie
docs.text:
Apprentice Pilot

Role: Worker · Age: Young

Careful, earnest and anxious to get everything right; she writes notes on the back of her hand.

Corrie is Kor's apprentice and learns more from his mistakes than his advice. Last month she saw something large and dark pass beneath a ship in the gap, and nobody has believed her yet.

Relationships:

  • Kor: mentor
  • Esk: friend

docs.title: Dougal
docs.text:
Night Watchman of the Quay

Role: Guard · Age: Elder

Sleepy-looking but sharp-eared; he tells terrible jokes to keep himself awake.

Dougal has walked the quay at night for thirty years, counting lanterns and boats. He has started finding wet, clawed tracks on the lowest steps some mornings and has told only Ruan.

Relationships:

  • Ruan: friend

docs.title: Dunmor
docs.text:
Lamplighter of the Quays

Role: Service · Age: Adult

Gentle, unhurried and content; he knows every lantern on the quay by its flicker.

Dunmor lights and tends the quay lanterns each evening and is married to Iska. He is the one person who can make the First Warden sit down and eat.

Relationships:

  • Iska: wife
  • Arlo: son
  • Gunna: lantern-maker

docs.title: Esk
docs.text:
Sellsword of the Wild Coast

Role: Adventurer · Age: Adult

Quiet, wary and courteous; she pays her debts and keeps her past to herself.

Esk came to Goa Harbour on a trading ship a few years ago and stayed to hunt monsters for whoever pays. She sails with fishing boats that go far out, and she has seen things in the deep water that she will only describe to Corrie.

Relationships:

  • Gwenna: friend
  • Teague: hopeful employer
  • Corrie: friend

docs.title: Tamsin
docs.text:
Boatwright

Role: Craftsman · Age: Adult

Fierce, inventive and never satisfied; she rebuilds the race boat every winter whether it needs it or not.

Tamsin builds and keeps Goa Harbour's race boat, the Gap Runner, and has sworn this is the summer it finally beats Bain Harbour. She wants timber from the deep forest, which is exactly where Haldor will not send his crews.

Relationships:

  • Calder: friend
  • Haldor: stubborn supplier
  • Iska: skipper
  • Jory: helper

docs.title: Jory
docs.text:
Race Crew

Role: Worker · Age: Young

Loud, loyal and tireless; he would row around Veligor alone if Iska asked him to.

Jory crewed the Gap Runner for the first time last summer and talks about nothing else. He works the quay the rest of the year, hauling timber and wool onto ships.

Relationships:

  • Iska: skipper
  • Tamsin: boss

docs.title: Arlo
docs.text:
Son of the First Warden

Role: Child · Age: Child

Serious, curious and stubborn; he asks why until the grown-ups give up.

Arlo is Iska and Dunmor's son and wants to be a sea warden like his mother and grandmother. He sneaks onto the quay at dawn to watch Varro read the water.

Relationships:

  • Iska: mother
  • Dunmor: father
  • Ysmay: grandmother
  • Varro: patient teacher
  • Eilidh: best friend

docs.title: Ruan
docs.text:
Captain of the Cliff Watch

Role: Guard · Age: Adult

Steady, broad-shouldered and few-worded; he trusts a good rope more than a good speech.

Ruan leads the small watch that guards the cliff stairs and the paths down from the forest. Since the Disturbance began, creatures have started climbing the cliffs at night, and he wants more lanterns on the high landings.

Relationships:

  • Moira: guard
  • Dougal: friend
  • Iska: First Warden

docs.title: Moira
docs.text:
Cliff Watch Guard

Role: Guard · Age: Young

Bold, restless and always the first to volunteer; she climbs the stairs two at a time for fun.

Moira joined the watch to see a monster up close and has now seen far more than she wanted. She would still rather be out with the hunters on the wild coast.

Relationships:

  • Ruan: captain
  • Torva: friend

docs.title: Gorm
docs.text:
Master of the Stairs

Role: Craftsman · Age: Adult

Stubborn, proud and secretly sentimental; he talks about stone the way others talk about family.

Gorm leads the builders who carve and mend the stairways and rope bridges that climb the cliffs. He wants to cut a new stair down to the far cove before the summer race, and he is behind.

Relationships:

  • Ulric: mentor
  • Kestra: builder
  • Hamish: friendly rival

docs.title: Kestra
docs.text:
Rope-Bridge Builder

Role: Craftsman · Age: Young

Fearless, light-footed and impatient with anyone who looks down.

Kestra strings the rope bridges between the cliff houses and can cross any of them blindfold. Something has been chewing the ropes on the highest bridge, and she means to catch it.

Relationships:

  • Gorm: master builder
  • Tarran: sweetheart

docs.title: Ulric
docs.text:
Stonecarver

Role: Craftsman · Age: Elder

Slow, thoughtful and kind; he carves a little animal into every step he cuts.

Ulric taught Gorm everything about stone and still carves the hardest steps himself. He hopes someone will notice that his little carvings, read from top to bottom, tell the story of the first camp.

Relationships:

  • Gorm: pupil

docs.title: Hamish
docs.text:
Rope-Lift Keeper

Role: Service · Age: Adult

Chatty, jolly and nosy; he knows everyone's business because everyone rides his lift.

Hamish works the rope lift that hauls goods and tired legs from the quay to the top of the cliffs. He dreams of building a second lift, if only Gorm would stop calling lifts lazy.

Relationships:

  • Gorm: friendly rival
  • Fionn: nephew

docs.title: Ysmay
docs.text:
Retired Sea Warden

Role: Resident · Age: Elder

Sharp as a hook and twice as stubborn; she watches the inlet from her window and criticises every pilot.

Ysmay was a sea warden for forty years and is Iska's mother. She never wanted to be First Warden herself and is fiercely proud that her daughter is.

Relationships:

  • Iska: daughter
  • Arlo: grandson
  • Varro: old friend

docs.title: Fionn
docs.text:
Stair Runner

Role: Child · Age: Child

Quick, cheeky and fearless; he knows every shortcut on the cliffs.

Fionn runs messages up and down the cliff stairs for a copper a trip. He follows the hunters to the edge of the forest whenever he can and thinks nobody has noticed.

Relationships:

  • Hamish: uncle
  • Torva: unfooled watcher

docs.title: Haldor
docs.text:
Head of the Timber Crews

Role: Worker · Age: Adult

Big, careful and soft-spoken; he thanks every tree before it falls.

Haldor leads the crews that cut timber where the forest meets the shore and float it round to the quay. He has had to pull his crews back from the deeper woods twice this year because of monsters.

Relationships:

  • Merrin: cutter
  • Osric: woodsman
  • Tamsin: demanding customer

docs.title: Merrin
docs.text:
Timber Cutter

Role: Worker · Age: Young

Fast, proud and competitive; she keeps a running tally of who has felled the most.

Merrin is the youngest cutter on Haldor's crew and wants to prove she can run a crew of her own. She and Kenna have been rivals since they were children.

Relationships:

  • Haldor: crew head
  • Kenna: rival

docs.title: Osric
docs.text:
Woodsman

Role: Worker · Age: Adult

Uneasy, watchful and superstitious; he will not work past sunset for any wage.

Osric was cutting alone deep in the forest last autumn when every bird went silent at once. He has not been back there, and he will not say what he saw.

Relationships:

  • Haldor: crew head
  • Elspeth: mother

docs.title: Torva
docs.text:
Hunter of the Wild Coast

Role: Adventurer · Age: Adult

Cool, scarred and dryly funny; she never boasts and never misses.

Torva leads the hunters who keep the monsters of the wild coast away from the town's paths and timber crews. Each year there are more of them and they come closer, and she wants to know why.

Relationships:

  • Moira: admirer
  • Caddoc: hunting partner
  • Kenna: apprentice
  • Elspeth: healer
  • Fionn: secret follower

docs.title: Caddoc
docs.text:
Trapper

Role: Adventurer · Age: Adult

Grumbling, cautious and clever with his hands; he complains constantly and never quits.

Caddoc sets traps along the shore for the creatures that come out of the forest at night. Something keeps springing his biggest traps without being caught, and it is starting to bother him.

Relationships:

  • Torva: hunting partner
  • Greer: buyer

docs.title: Kenna
docs.text:
Young Hunter

Role: Adventurer · Age: Young

Restless, proud and quick to anger, but fiercely loyal to her friends.

Kenna is Torva's newest hunter and wants to bring down something big enough to be talked about at the Gap Inn. She still has not forgiven Merrin for a race they ran when they were nine.

Relationships:

  • Merrin: rival
  • Torva: mentor

docs.title: Elspeth
docs.text:
Healer

Role: Healer · Age: Elder · Sells: Sea-herb salves, poultices and tonics

Serene, firm and quietly funny; she scolds her patients and then tucks them in.

Elspeth keeps the sea-herb remedies that the Magicians of the first camp brought to the shore. Since the hunters started bringing in so many wounds, she can barely gather herbs fast enough.

Relationships:

  • Osric: son
  • Brigid: apprentice
  • Torva: patient

docs.title: Brigid
docs.text:
Herb Gatherer

Role: Healer · Age: Young

Shy, gentle and observant; she notices everything and says very little.

Brigid gathers sea-herbs on the rocks for Elspeth at low tide. Some of the herb beds she has picked all her life have started to wither, and she is afraid to tell Elspeth.

Relationships:

  • Elspeth: teacher

docs.title: Brodie
docs.text:
Fishmonger

Role: Merchant · Age: Adult · Sells: Fresh fish, smoked fish and salted fish for the road

Booming, cheerful and a born haggler; he names every fish he sells.

Brodie buys from the coves and sells at the Lantern Market, and his smoked fish goes out on ships all over Veligor. He owes Sorcha a favour he keeps forgetting to repay.

Relationships:

  • Sorcha: supplier
  • Bethoc: sweetheart

docs.title: Greer
docs.text:
Fur Trader

Role: Merchant · Age: Adult · Sells: Furs, pelts, fur-lined cloaks and hoods

Shrewd, stylish and charming; she always knows who is selling cheap and who is buying dear.

Greer buys pelts from the hunters and the highland trappers and ships them all over the island. Fewer trappers come down from the hills each year, and her prices are climbing.

Relationships:

  • Caddoc: supplier
  • Morag: friendly competitor

docs.title: Morag
docs.text:
Wool Trader

Role: Merchant · Age: Elder · Sells: Highland wool, knitted jumpers, blankets and sea-mittens

Motherly, nosy and generous; she feeds everyone who stops at her stall.

Morag has traded highland wool at the Lantern Market for forty years and knits through every conversation. She worries about her drover Teague every time he takes the hill road.

Relationships:

  • Greer: friendly competitor
  • Teague: drover

docs.title: Teague
docs.text:
Highland Drover

Role: Worker · Age: Adult

Easygoing, weathered and full of stories that grow with each telling.

Teague brings wool and pelts down from the highlands by the hill road to the coast. Monsters on that road cost him half a flock last spring, and he is looking for brave company for the next trip.

Relationships:

  • Morag: employer
  • Esk: possible guard

docs.title: Gunna
docs.text:
Master Lantern-Maker

Role: Craftsman · Age: Elder · Sells: Quay lanterns, hand lanterns and storm lanterns

Calm, mysterious and gently teasing; she answers questions with questions.

Gunna makes the forest-crafted lanterns that light Goa Harbour's quays at night, using a craft handed down from the Magicians of the first camp. She is looking for an apprentice worthy of her oldest secrets.

Relationships:

  • Tarran: apprentice
  • Dunmor: lamplighter

docs.title: Tarran
docs.text:
Lantern-Maker's Apprentice

Role: Craftsman · Age: Young

Eager, clumsy and full of ideas; half of his lanterns are brilliant and half of them do not light.

Tarran is Gunna's apprentice and is sure she is keeping the best part of the craft from him. He wants to make a lantern bright enough to drive monsters off the cliff landings.

Relationships:

  • Gunna: master
  • Kestra: sweetheart

docs.title: Gwenna
docs.text:
Outfitter

Role: Merchant · Age: Adult · Sells: Rope, grappling hooks, torches, waxed cloaks and travel food

Brisk, honest and unsentimental; she will tell you exactly why your plan will get you killed.

Gwenna outfits the adventurers who come to hunt on the wild coast. She was one herself until a bad fall in the sea caves, and she keeps a list of everyone who has gone in and not come back.

Relationships:

  • Lachlan: pestering customer
  • Esk: friend

docs.title: Bethoc
docs.text:
Keeper of the Gap Inn

Role: Service · Age: Adult · Sells: Hot stew, ale and rooms for the night

Warm, quick-witted and unshockable; she has heard every sailor's story twice.

Bethoc runs the Gap Inn, where sailors, hunters and travellers end up sooner or later. She keeps a board of monster sightings on the wall, and the hunters check it every morning.

Relationships:

  • Cormac: regular
  • Mhairi: fiddler
  • Brodie: sweetheart

docs.title: Lachlan
docs.text:
Adventurer

Role: Adventurer · Age: Young

Bright, boastful and generous; he makes friends in minutes and plans in seconds.

Lachlan grew up in the coves and wants to be the first to map the sea caves under the cliffs. He keeps asking Gwenna for her old maps, and she keeps saying no.

Relationships:

  • Ronan: admirer
  • Gwenna: reluctant advisor

docs.title: Cormac
docs.text:
Shanty Singer

Role: Performer · Age: Elder

Theatrical, sentimental and a shameless flatterer; he cries at his own songs.

Cormac sings the old songs of the shared camp, where Savage hunters and Magicians first fished the inlet together. He swears he knows a verse about the gap that nobody else remembers, and that it is important.

Relationships:

  • Bethoc: landlady
  • Mhairi: pupil

docs.title: Mhairi
docs.text:
Fiddler

Role: Performer · Age: Young

Mischievous, bright and tireless; she plays faster when people try to stop dancing.

Mhairi plays at the Gap Inn and at the summer race send-off. She is writing a song about the race and needs Goa Harbour to win so she can finish it.

Relationships:

  • Bethoc: employer
  • Cormac: old mentor

docs.title: Sorcha
docs.text:
Cove Fisher

Role: Worker · Age: Adult

Loud, warm and practical; she runs her boat and her family the same way, with a lot of shouting and a lot of love.

Sorcha fishes the coves with her husband Calder and has the best catch of any boat in the town. She has stopped taking her children out past the point since the sea turned rougher.

Relationships:

  • Calder: husband
  • Eilidh: daughter
  • Ronan: son
  • Agna: mother
  • Brodie: buyer

docs.title: Calder
docs.text:
Cove Fisher

Role: Worker · Age: Adult

Quiet, patient and endlessly mending something; he hums old camp songs while he works.

Calder is the calm half of the best boat in the coves. He wants to build a bigger boat one day and race it around Veligor himself.

Relationships:

  • Sorcha: wife
  • Eilidh: daughter
  • Ronan: son
  • Tamsin: friend

docs.title: Eilidh
docs.text:
Fisher's Daughter

Role: Child · Age: Child

Bossy, clever and impossible to fool; she keeps her little brother in line.

Eilidh can already gut a fish faster than most grown-ups. She wants to be a sea warden and practises reading the tide from the cove rocks every evening.

Relationships:

  • Sorcha: mother
  • Calder: father
  • Ronan: brother
  • Arlo: best friend

docs.title: Ronan
docs.text:
Fisher's Son

Role: Child · Age: Child

Dreamy, curious and always wandering off; he collects shells, feathers and anything that glows.

Ronan found a strange smooth stone in a tide pool that he keeps hidden in his pocket. He wants to go with the adventurers to the sea caves, which nobody will allow.

Relationships:

  • Sorcha: mother
  • Calder: father
  • Eilidh: sister
  • Lachlan: hero

docs.title: Agna
docs.text:
Net-Mender

Role: Craftsman · Age: Elder

Blunt, wry and tireless; she has an opinion about everyone's knots.

Agna has mended the coves' nets for fifty years and remembers when the sea was calm enough to fish at night. Lately she finds nets torn by something with teeth far bigger than any fish she knows.

Relationships:

  • Sorcha: daughter

docs.title: People of Kaldemor
docs.text: The 40 people of Kaldemor in the game's first release.

docs.title: Leaders
docs.text: • Tobin, Mayor of Kaldemor

docs.title: Everyone
docs.text: Name Title Where Role Tobin Mayor of Kaldemor Town Square Ruler Lia Town Guide Town Square Official Tam Would-be Warrior Town Square Child Nell Cloud Counter Town Square Child Pell Taxi Driver Town Square Service Mildred Town Clerk Town Square Official Rufus Town Crier Town Square Official Lottie Schoolteacher Town Square Scholar Jem Fiddler Town Square Performer Bram Potion Seller Kaldemor Market Merchant Gareth Smith Kaldemor Market Craftsman Old Marta Grocer Kaldemor Market Merchant Hilda Storage Keeper Kaldemor Market Service Rosa Baker Kaldemor Market Merchant Bess Herbalist Kaldemor Market Healer Molly Innkeeper of the Sleepy Snail Kaldemor Market Service Hale Park Ranger Kaldemor Park Guard Quill Drillmaster Kaldemor Park Guard Ewan Clockkeeper Kaldemor Park Worker Fen Mushroom House Fan Kaldemor Park Child Orin Retired Woodcutter Kaldemor Park Resident Wren Orin's Wife Kaldemor Park Resident Garrick The Climber Kaldemor Park Adventurer Hob Miller Kaldemor Park Worker Meg Snail Hunter Kaldemor Park Adventurer Digby Gauntlet Hopeful Kaldemor Park Adventurer Wilbur Farmer Farms Worker Hattie Beekeeper Farms Merchant Elsie Dairy Farmer Farms Worker Dottie Shepherd Girl Farms Child Clem Orchard Keeper Farms Worker Wilf Spore Gatherer Farms Worker Alfie Head of the Carpenters' Guild Workshops Craftsman Archie Carpenter's Apprentice Workshops Craftsman Bertie Mushroom House Shaper Workshops Craftsman Daisy House Painter Workshops Craftsman Mabel Potter Workshops Craftsman Percy Wheelwright Workshops Craftsman Winnie Weaver Workshops Craftsman Ned Cobbler Workshops Craftsman

docs.title: Tobin
docs.text:
Mayor of Kaldemor

Role: Ruler · Age: Elder · In the game: Tobin

Warm, chatty and proud of his town, with a story for every occasion and a joke about the snails for every other one. He knows every family by name and most of their grandparents too.

Tobin has been mayor for thirty years and likes to say the great treehouse has outlived three mayors, himself included. Just under three hundred people live in Kaldemor, and he means to see every one of them safe. His current project is a new fence around the gardens, with ground snail shell mixed into the mortar.

Relationships:

  • Lia: trusted guide
  • Mildred: clerk
  • Hale: ranger
  • Rosa: baker
  • Ewan: old friend
  • Tam: admirer
  • Quenna: trading partner

docs.title: Lia
docs.text:
Town Guide

Role: Official · Age: Young · In the game: Lia

Bright, quick and endlessly patient with newcomers, she answers the same question for the tenth time as if it were the first. She always knows the latest news in town before anyone else.

Lia meets every newcomer in the square and shows them the way to the Market, the Park and the fields beyond. She was the one who first spread word that the clock tower had stopped. She is courting Clem the orchard keeper and pretends nobody has noticed.

Relationships:

  • Clem: sweetheart
  • Tobin: mentor

docs.title: Tam
docs.text:
Would-be Warrior

Role: Child · Age: Child · In the game: Tam

Bold, loud and only a little afraid of snails, he swings a stick at anything that looks like an enemy. He hates washing behind his ears.

Tam is going to be a warrior when he grows up, and he tells everyone so. He hangs about the Park hoping Quill will let him run the Gauntlet, and Mayor Tobin has told him he could even be mayor one day, if he washes.

Relationships:

  • Wilbur: father
  • Hattie: mother
  • Tobin: kindly mayor
  • Quill: hero
  • Nell: friend
  • Fen: friend

docs.title: Nell
docs.text:
Cloud Counter

Role: Child · Age: Child · In the game: Nell

Dreamy and very serious about her counting, she shushes grown-ups who interrupt. She sees snails, carts and teapots in every cloud.

Nell spends whole afternoons lying on the square counting clouds, in the cap her grandmother Wren knitted for her. She keeps a tally of every cloud she has ever counted in a little book and will not say how big the number is.

Relationships:

  • Hob: father
  • Mabel: mother
  • Orin: grandfather
  • Wren: grandmother
  • Tam: friend
  • Fen: friend
  • Lottie: teacher

docs.title: Pell
docs.text:
Taxi Driver

Role: Service · Age: Adult · In the game: Pell

Steady and plain-spoken, he never hurries a fare and never misses one either. He has opinions about every road on Veligor.

Pell drives the Kaldemor cab from the stand by the signpost, between towns and never into the wilds. Lately he drives the Royal Road a little faster than he used to, and he will not say what ran at his cab last month, only that Percy had to mend the wheel.

Relationships:

  • Percy: wheelwright

docs.title: Mildred
docs.text:
Town Clerk

Role: Official · Age: Adult

Neat, dry and exact, she has never misspelled a name in the town ledger. Her rare smile is worth waiting for.

Mildred keeps the town's ledgers, the mayor's letters and the list of every family in Kaldemor. She has counted the town more carefully than Tobin ever has, and she quietly worries about what will happen to Kaldemor on the day he decides to rest.

Relationships:

  • Tobin: mayor
  • Rufus: town crier

docs.title: Rufus
docs.text:
Town Crier

Role: Official · Age: Adult

Booming, jolly and impossible to ignore, he cannot say anything quietly, not even good morning. He loves a good announcement more than a good dinner.

Rufus rings his handbell in the square every morning with the news, the fair days and the lost cats. These days more of his notices are road warnings, and he has started reading them a little more gently so as not to frighten the children.

Relationships:

  • Mildred: clerk who writes his notices

docs.title: Lottie
docs.text:
Schoolteacher

Role: Scholar · Age: Adult

Kind, curious and a little scatterbrained, she loses her spectacles on her head several times a day. She never answers a child's question with "because".

Lottie teaches the town's children in a schoolroom up in the great treehouse. She collects every version of the one-seed story she can find, and lately the children ask her about the monsters on the roads and the old seal, and she is not sure what to tell them.

Relationships:

  • Nell: pupil
  • Fen: pupil

docs.title: Jem
docs.text:
Fiddler

Role: Performer · Age: Young

Cheerful, restless and always tapping a foot, he cannot sit through a conversation without humming. He makes up songs about whoever is listening.

Jem plays his fiddle in the square by day and at the Sleepy Snail by night, and no harvest dance in Kaldemor starts without him. He is writing a song for Daisy the painter and has been for a year, because it is never good enough.

Relationships:

  • Daisy: friend
  • Molly: innkeeper

docs.title: Bram
docs.text:
Potion Seller

Role: Merchant · Age: Adult · Sells: Potions · In the game: Bram

Friendly to every customer and stubborn with everyone else, he can talk about cauldrons for an hour. He admits he is wrong about once a year.

Bram keeps the potion stall at the far end of the Market and teaches brewing to anyone with the hands for it. Years ago he quarrelled with Rosa over a loaf, and he has missed her bread and her company ever since without saying so.

Relationships:

  • Bess: older sister
  • Wilf: spore supplier
  • Rosa: estranged friend

docs.title: Gareth
docs.text:
Smith

Role: Craftsman · Age: Adult · Sells: Swords, shields and armour · In the game: Gareth

Broad, quiet and proud of a clean edge, he talks more to his anvil than to people. He thinks every smith should start with copper.

Gareth works the forge in the Market and sells blades to the young warriors heading out to the fields. He teaches smelting and the use of upgrade scrolls, and he has been asked for more swords this year than in the five before it.

Relationships:

  • Percy: customer
  • Hilda: neighbour

docs.title: Old Marta
docs.text:
Grocer

Role: Merchant · Age: Elder · Sells: Fresh produce, pickles and groceries · In the game: Old Marta

Sharp-tongued, sharp-eyed and secretly soft, she will scold a customer for squeezing a tomato and then slip them an extra one. Nobody has ever won an argument with her.

Old Marta has run the grocer's stall for longer than anyone can remember, buying from every farm around Kaldemor. Her pickles and Elsie's cheese have fought for first prize at the harvest fair for twenty years.

Relationships:

  • Wilbur: supplier
  • Mabel: potter
  • Elsie: old rival

docs.title: Hilda
docs.text:
Storage Keeper

Role: Service · Age: Adult · In the game: Hilda

Calm, careful and a little mysterious, she remembers where every single item in her storage sits. She takes her promise to look after things very seriously.

Hilda keeps the town's storage, where travellers leave meso and goods too heavy to carry. In all her years she has never lost a thing, and she would very much like to keep it that way.

Relationships:

  • Molly: sister
  • Gareth: neighbour

docs.title: Rosa
docs.text:
Baker

Role: Merchant · Age: Adult · Sells: Bread, buns and her famous mushroom bread · In the game: Rosa

Warm, floury and a born feeder, she calls everyone "dear" and saves the heel of the loaf for her friends. She is private about the things that matter most to her.

Rosa bakes in the terrace oven her grandmother built, brick by brick, the year the clock tower was raised; it has not gone cold since. Her mushroom bread needs spores and a pinch of ground blue snail shell. She has never mended an old quarrel with Bram, and she wishes she had.

Relationships:

  • Wilf: spore supplier
  • Hob: miller
  • Bram: estranged friend
  • Tobin: regular customer
  • Fen: flour carrier

docs.title: Bess
docs.text:
Herbalist

Role: Healer · Age: Elder · Sells: Herbs, poultices and teas

Brisk, practical and fond of telling people they should have come sooner. She trusts a leaf over a potion every time.

Bess is Bram's older sister and the town's healer, binding the cuts and bites that come back from the fields. She tells Bram that his potions are only herbs in a hurry, and he tells her that her teas are only potions that gave up. She has treated more snail nips this year than ever before.

Relationships:

  • Bram: younger brother

docs.title: Molly
docs.text:
Innkeeper of the Sleepy Snail

Role: Service · Age: Adult

Bustling, motherly and nosy in the nicest way, she knows every traveller's business before their soup is served. She cannot stand an empty plate.

Molly runs the Sleepy Snail, the inn at the edge of the Market where travellers stop before the eastern countryside. She sends guests with heavy packs to her sister Hilda. Fewer travellers come in from the east these days, and the ones who do arrive with stories she would rather not believe.

Relationships:

  • Hilda: sister
  • Jem: fiddler

docs.title: Hale
docs.text:
Park Ranger

Role: Guard · Age: Adult · In the game: Hale

Quiet, watchful and slow to worry, which makes it serious when he does. He says more with a nod than most people say in a speech.

Hale looks after the park gate and the meadow beyond it, and pays a bounty to anyone who thins out the snails. He was the first to hear something huge settle in a hollow past the woods, and he kept it to himself until he knew what it was.

Relationships:

  • Tobin: mayor
  • Meg: scout
  • Quill: old comrade

docs.title: Quill
docs.text:
Drillmaster

Role: Guard · Age: Adult · In the game: Quill

Stern, clipped and fair, he barks orders but never mocks a fall. He believes footwork wins more fights than muscle.

Quill runs the Kaldemor Gauntlet in the Park, a three-stage course of a monster yard, a hanging course and a last stand. He drills the young warriors who mean to protect the fields, and he has more of them than ever. He pretends not to notice Tam watching every run.

Relationships:

  • Digby: recruit
  • Hale: old comrade
  • Tam: would-be pupil

docs.title: Ewan
docs.text:
Clockkeeper

Role: Worker · Age: Elder · In the game: Ewan

Fussy, gentle and proud, he talks to the clock as if it could hear him and listens to it as if it could answer. He cannot stand dust, or people touching things that swing.

Ewan has kept the clock tower for forty years, winding, oiling and listening. When a Shroom carried off the great gear, it was the first time the clock had ever stopped, and he still checks the gear every morning to be sure it is there.

Relationships:

  • Alfie: friend
  • Tobin: old friend
  • Garrick: uninvited climber
  • Archie: nervous young neighbour

docs.title: Fen
docs.text:
Mushroom House Fan

Role: Child · Age: Child · In the game: Fen

Wide-eyed and full of questions, she notices the small things everyone else walks past. She thinks every squirrel has a secret.

Fen loves the mushroom houses and measures them every spring to see how much they have grown. She carries flour for Rosa in exchange for buns and follows Bertie around his work, hoping he will let her fit a window one day.

Relationships:

  • Rosa: kindly baker
  • Bertie: hero
  • Tam: friend
  • Nell: friend
  • Lottie: teacher

docs.title: Orin
docs.text:
Retired Woodcutter

Role: Resident · Age: Elder · In the game: Orin

Slow, warm and a little deaf, he tells the same stories over and over and enjoys them more each time. He still judges every tree he sees by how it would fall.

Orin felled trees for forty winters and now counts them from his bench in the Park. He says the treehouse was a sapling when his grandfather was a boy, and nobody has the heart to argue. He and Wren have been married for more than fifty years.

Relationships:

  • Wren: wife
  • Hob: son
  • Nell: granddaughter
  • Ned: oldest friend

docs.title: Wren
docs.text:
Orin's Wife

Role: Resident · Age: Elder · In the game: Wren

Gentle, patient and gently teasing, she never tires of Orin's stories, though she tells him when he is shouting. Her knitting needles are never still.

Wren knits caps for every child in Kaldemor, and some of them even wear them; her granddaughter Nell never takes hers off. She spends her afternoons in the Park beside Orin, because the Park is nicest in the afternoon.

Relationships:

  • Orin: husband
  • Hob: son
  • Nell: granddaughter
  • Winnie: friend

docs.title: Garrick
docs.text:
The Climber

Role: Adventurer · Age: Adult · In the game: Garrick

Easygoing, odd and fond of a good saying, he is happiest anywhere higher than everyone else. He thinks up is just a direction.

Garrick lives up on a ledge above the Park fountain, where fewer people ask him what he is doing. He teaches Rope Up to anyone who has climbed to the lookout on Kaldemor Hills, and he has climbed the clock tower more often than Ewan would like.

Relationships:

  • Ewan: exasperated clockkeeper

docs.title: Hob
docs.text:
Miller

Role: Worker · Age: Adult

Easygoing and dusty from head to toe, he whistles along with the creak of the sails. He worries about the weather the way other people worry about money.

Hob runs the windmills in the Park and grinds the flour for half the town, Rosa's oven first of all. He is Orin and Wren's son, and the only woodcutter's child in Kaldemor who never wanted to swing an axe.

Relationships:

  • Orin: father
  • Wren: mother
  • Mabel: wife
  • Nell: daughter
  • Rosa: best customer

docs.title: Meg
docs.text:
Snail Hunter

Role: Adventurer · Age: Young

Cocky, quick and brave a step past sensible, she keeps a running count of every snail she has beaten and adds a few. Underneath the boasting she cares a great deal about the farms.

Meg hunts the meadow for Hale's bounty and scouts the edge of the woods for him when he is busy. She has been out past the hills further than she has admitted to anyone, and she swears the ground shook under her feet.

Relationships:

  • Hale: mentor
  • Digby: rival

docs.title: Digby
docs.text:
Gauntlet Hopeful

Role: Adventurer · Age: Young

Earnest, clumsy and impossible to discourage, he gets up from every fall grinning. He believes hard work beats talent, and he has had to.

Digby was a farmhand for Wilbur until he decided to become a warrior, and he still helps with the harvest. He has failed Quill's hanging course eleven times and means to pass it before the leaves turn.

Relationships:

  • Wilbur: former employer
  • Quill: drillmaster
  • Meg: rival

docs.title: Wilbur
docs.text:
Farmer

Role: Worker · Age: Adult

Big, cheerful and stubborn as a turnip, he loves his fields and talks to his pumpkins. He takes the snails personally.

Wilbur grows pumpkins, turnips and beans on the biggest farm east of the square, and sells most of it to Old Marta. The snails ate his prize pumpkin the week before last year's fair, and he has sworn it will not happen again.

Relationships:

  • Hattie: wife
  • Tam: son
  • Digby: former farmhand
  • Old Marta: grocer

docs.title: Hattie
docs.text:
Beekeeper

Role: Merchant · Age: Adult · Sells: Honey, beeswax and candles

Sunny, calm and hard to sting, in either sense. She talks softly, so the bees and her son both listen.

Hattie keeps the hives at the edge of the farms and is married to Wilbur. Her son Tam wants to be a warrior and she wants him to be careful, and she has not yet found a way to want both at once.

Relationships:

  • Wilbur: husband
  • Tam: son
  • Clem: neighbour

docs.title: Elsie
docs.text:
Dairy Farmer

Role: Worker · Age: Elder · Sells: Milk, butter and cheese

Proud, plain and up before the sun, she has a firm opinion about everything and a name for every cow. She does not believe in fuss.

Elsie keeps the dairy herd and makes the cheese that has fought Old Marta's pickles at the harvest fair for twenty years. Her cows will no longer graze the far pasture by the woods, and she has never known them to be wrong about anything.

Relationships:

  • Dottie: granddaughter
  • Old Marta: old rival

docs.title: Dottie
docs.text:
Shepherd Girl

Role: Child · Age: Child

Small, determined and very fond of her sheep, she counts them twice before bed. She does not like to be told she is too young for anything.

Dottie minds her grandmother Elsie's sheep on the hills and sells their wool to Winnie the weaver. One of her lambs wandered toward the woods a week ago and has not come back, and she has not told her grandmother yet.

Relationships:

  • Elsie: grandmother
  • Winnie: weaver

docs.title: Clem
docs.text:
Orchard Keeper

Role: Worker · Age: Young

Shy, gentle and happiest up a ladder among the apples. He goes red whenever Lia waves.

Clem looks after the orchards between the farms and the woods, and Hattie's bees keep his blossoms busy every spring. Something has been gnawing the roots of the trees nearest the woods, and it is not a snail.

Relationships:

  • Lia: sweetheart
  • Hattie: neighbour

docs.title: Wilf
docs.text:
Spore Gatherer

Role: Worker · Age: Adult · Sells: Mushroom spores and caps

Wiry, wry and happiest in the damp, he knows every mushroom by smell. He grumbles about everything except mushrooms.

Wilf gathers mushroom spores for Rosa's bread and Bram's potions and grows a few caps behind his cottage. He has just come back from visiting his sister and found the Shrooms in the woods far bolder than before, too bold for him to gather alone.

Relationships:

  • Rosa: customer
  • Bram: customer

docs.title: Alfie
docs.text:
Head of the Carpenters' Guild

Role: Craftsman · Age: Adult

Careful, patient and proud of a square joint, he measures three times and cuts once. He hums when the work is going well and goes silent when it is not.

Alfie leads the town's carpenters and keeps the great treehouse and the clock tower stairs in good repair. While mending an old beam in the treehouse he found a carving nobody can explain, and he has told only Ewan about it.

Relationships:

  • Archie: apprentice
  • Ewan: friend

docs.title: Archie
docs.text:
Carpenter's Apprentice

Role: Craftsman · Age: Young

Eager, careless and full of big ideas, he starts three things before finishing one. He is very good at saying sorry.

Archie is Alfie's apprentice and dreams of building a treehouse even taller than the great one. He cracked a rung on the clock tower ladder last spring and has been too afraid of Ewan to own up.

Relationships:

  • Alfie: master
  • Ewan: clockkeeper

docs.title: Bertie
docs.text:
Mushroom House Shaper

Role: Craftsman · Age: Elder

Twinkly, unhurried and full of riddles, he treats every mushroom house like an old friend. He never measures; he says the mushroom tells him.

Bertie hollows out the town's mushroom houses and fits them with doors, windows and new rooms as they grow each spring. He has been doing it for fifty years and lets young Fen carry his tools. His granddaughter Daisy paints the houses he shapes.

Relationships:

  • Daisy: granddaughter
  • Fen: little helper

docs.title: Daisy
docs.text:
House Painter

Role: Craftsman · Age: Young

Lively, messy and never seen without paint on her nose, she thinks no colour is too bright. She is cheerfully deaf to compliments.

Daisy paints the mushroom houses that her grandfather Bertie shapes, and half the shutters in Kaldemor. She has no idea that Jem has been writing her a song for a year, or she pretends not to.

Relationships:

  • Bertie: grandfather
  • Jem: admirer

docs.title: Mabel
docs.text:
Potter

Role: Craftsman · Age: Adult · Sells: Pots, jugs and bowls

Calm, practical and good with her hands, she can tell what a pot is for before it leaves the wheel. She laughs from the belly.

Mabel throws the pots, jugs and bowls of Kaldemor, including the crocks Old Marta keeps her pickles in. She is married to Hob the miller and is Nell's mother, and she has long given up calling Nell in from the clouds.

Relationships:

  • Hob: husband
  • Nell: daughter
  • Old Marta: customer

docs.title: Percy
docs.text:
Wheelwright

Role: Craftsman · Age: Adult

Methodical, gloomy in a comfortable way and secretly very kind, he expects every wheel to break and is glad when it does not.

Percy builds and mends the carts, barrows and the town cab. He has mended more broken wheels from the Royal Road this year than ever, and he does not like the marks on some of them.

Relationships:

  • Pell: friend and customer
  • Gareth: smith

docs.title: Winnie
docs.text:
Weaver

Role: Craftsman · Age: Adult · Sells: Wool, cloth and blankets

Chatty, warm and always half-listening to her loom, she can weave and gossip at the same time. She keeps a scrap of every cloth she has made.

Winnie weaves the wool from Dottie's sheep into cloth and blankets and spins yarn for Wren's caps. She has noticed Dottie bringing less wool lately and suspects the girl is keeping a worry to herself.

Relationships:

  • Dottie: wool supplier
  • Wren: friend

docs.title: Ned
docs.text:
Cobbler

Role: Craftsman · Age: Elder · Sells: Boots and shoes

Grumpy, honest and very slow, he will tell you your boots are a disgrace before he mends them beautifully. He does not trust anything that was made in a hurry.

Ned has made the boots of Kaldemor for fifty years and judges people by how they walk. He and Orin have been friends since they were boys and still argue about who won a race neither of them remembers.

Relationships:

  • Orin: oldest friend

docs.title: People of Midbarium
docs.text: The 25 people of Midbarium in the game's first release.

docs.title: Leaders
docs.text:
• Hask, The Old One
  • Dorrek, Chieftain of the Kragvar
  • Sennu, Chieftain of the Tolmach
  • Tavi, Chieftain of the Uskari
  • Odda, Chieftain of the Brenna

docs.title: Everyone

docs.title: Hask
docs.text:
The Old One

Role: Ruler · Age: Adult · Family: Uskari

Quiet, patient and hard to rattle; Hask listens to a whole loud council without a word, then speaks once and plainly.

Hask was born an Uskari and led the family as its chieftain until Old One Varra of the Brenna died and the four families chose Hask to follow her. Hask gave up the Uskari chieftainship that same night, as custom asks, and is one of the youngest Old Ones the Brenna songs name. Hask's private worry is that the canyon patrols are stretched thinner every season, and that the families are too proud to say so in council.

Relationships:

  • Zirra: older sister
  • Tavi: successor
  • Ulm: keeper of the fire and trusted counsel
  • Dorrek: blunt but loyal critic
  • Odda: host of the choosing and adviser

docs.title: Ulm
docs.text:
Keeper of the Council Fire

Role: Official · Age: Elder · Family: Kragvar

Gruff, slow-moving and fiercely proud of his duty; he talks to the fire more kindly than to most people.

Ulm has tended the fire in the great hall for forty years and has never once let it burn low. He knows every Kragvar song about the fighters who stayed beneath the World Tree, and lately he wonders aloud whether anyone down there still remembers the Kragvar.

Relationships:

  • Dorrek: son
  • Korrin: grandson
  • Hask: the Old One he serves

docs.title: Thrun
docs.text:
Drummer of the Gatherings

Role: Performer · Age: Elder · Family: Brenna

Loud, warm and impossible to embarrass; Thrun laughs from the belly and drums the same way.

Thrun beats the great drum that calls the four families to every choosing and every feast. Thrun drummed for the choosing of Old One Hask and swears it was the finest night of drumming in a generation, though the drum's old hide has since split and needs replacing with the skin of a beast few hunters would dare to track.

Relationships:

  • Odda: wife
  • Lessa: daughter
  • Vosk: old friend

docs.title: Gorra
docs.text:
Cistern Keeper

Role: Worker · Age: Adult · Family: Kragvar

Brisk, practical and always counting; Gorra measures water the way merchants measure coin.

Gorra keeps the stone cisterns that water the terraces and knows to the bucket how long the town can last in a dry year. One of the oldest cisterns has started losing water through a crack nobody can find, and she would quietly reward anyone who could track it down.

Relationships:

  • Dorrek: husband
  • Brakka: daughter
  • Korrin: son
  • Yarrek: water-sharing neighbour

docs.title: Korrin
docs.text:
Chieftain's Son

Role: Child · Age: Child · Family: Kragvar

Bold, scabby-kneed and always climbing something he was told not to climb.

Korrin is Dorrek's youngest and spends his days scrambling between the terraces with his friend Kesh. He wants to join the Uskari on the trail watch when he grows up, which his Kragvar family finds very funny and slightly insulting.

Relationships:

  • Dorrek: father
  • Gorra: mother
  • Ulm: grandfather
  • Kesh: best friend
  • Bekk: hero

docs.title: Imre
docs.text:
Stargazer

Role: Scholar · Age: Adult · Family: none

Dreamy, absent-minded and delighted by everything; Imre forgets meals but never forgets a star.

Imre came to Midbarium to study its famous night skies and stayed for the stars and the hospitality. Imre spends nights on the highest terrace charting the heavens and swapping star stories with the Brenna, and hopes one day to be invited to recite at a gathering.

Relationships:

  • Ahvi: friend
  • Corwell: landlord

docs.title: Dorrek
docs.text:
Chieftain of the Kragvar

Role: Ruler · Age: Adult · Family: Kragvar

Blunt, broad-shouldered and stubborn as granite, but scrupulously fair once he has made up his mind.

Dorrek was chosen chieftain when his uncle died in a rockfall, and he still climbs the highest scaffold himself before he lets any mason on it. He argued long in council for a Kragvar Old One, lost to the families' choice of Hask, and has stood by that decision without a word of complaint ever since.

Relationships:

  • Gorra: wife
  • Brakka: daughter
  • Korrin: son
  • Ulm: father
  • Vosk: cousin
  • Hask: respected chieftain

docs.title: Brakka
docs.text:
Apprentice Mason

Role: Craftsman · Age: Young · Family: Kragvar

Eager, restless and quick with a chisel; Brakka would rather carve something new than mend something old.

Brakka is Dorrek's daughter and is learning the mason's trade from Vosk. She dreams of carving a new stairway down the cliff to the valley floor, the first new route in a hundred years, and has already sketched it on every flat stone she can find.

Relationships:

  • Dorrek: father
  • Gorra: mother
  • Vosk: mentor

docs.title: Vosk
docs.text:
Master of Bridges

Role: Craftsman · Age: Elder · Family: Kragvar

Careful, dry-humoured and suspicious of anything that sways; he trusts a knot only after he has tied it himself.

Vosk keeps every rope-and-plank bridge in Midbarium sound and has taught three generations of Kragvar how to splice a cable. Twice this season he has found ropes on the far canyon bridge gnawed half through in the night, and he does not know what is doing it.

Relationships:

  • Brakka: apprentice
  • Dorrek: cousin
  • Thrun: old friend

docs.title: Sennu
docs.text:
Chieftain of the Tolmach

Role: Ruler · Age: Adult · Family: Tolmach

Weathered, wry and unhurried; Sennu has a herder's patience and a herder's habit of counting heads twice.

Sennu leads the Tolmach from a hide tent like any other herder, and moves the camps with the seasons as the family always has. This year Sennu has kept the herds closer to town than ever before because of the monsters in the low valleys, and the high pastures are starting to suffer for it.

Relationships:

  • Mabbu: mother
  • Harra: sister
  • Ennek: son
  • Tavi: uneasy ally on the trails

docs.title: Mabbu
docs.text:
Elder of the Camps

Role: Resident · Age: Elder · Family: Tolmach

Sharp-tongued, sharp-eyed and endlessly hospitable; she will scold a guest and feed them in the same breath.

Mabbu is mother to Sennu and Harra and has walked every herding path in the highlands at least a hundred times. Her knees no longer let her follow the herds, so she keeps the home camp and remembers, out loud, every spring that ran in every dry year.

Relationships:

  • Sennu: daughter
  • Harra: daughter
  • Lessa: healer

docs.title: Yarrek
docs.text:
Goat Herder

Role: Worker · Age: Adult · Family: Tolmach

Gentle, slow to speak and devoted to his goats, each of which he knows by name.

Yarrek leads the family's goats between the high pastures and the camps. Last month three of his goats came back from the valley wild-eyed and biting, and he keeps them penned apart, hoping they will calm.

Relationships:

  • Harra: wife
  • Kesh: son
  • Gorra: water-sharing neighbour

docs.title: Kesh
docs.text:
Young Goatherd

Role: Child · Age: Child · Family: Tolmach

Chatty, curious and fearless; Kesh asks every traveler where they came from and what the road was like.

Kesh is Harra and Yarrek's son and is trusted with the kids of the herd, though not yet with the grown goats. He and Korrin have a secret lookout above the terraces where they watch for monsters and, so far, mostly see eagles.

Relationships:

  • Yarrek: father
  • Harra: mother
  • Ennek: cousin
  • Korrin: best friend

docs.title: Tavi
docs.text:
Chieftain of the Uskari

Role: Ruler · Age: Adult · Family: Uskari

Restless, direct and competitive; Tavi would rather walk the trail than talk about it, and hates losing at anything.

Tavi left the rim as a young adventurer and spent a season training with the swordsmen of the capital before coming home to hunt. When Hask was chosen Old One, the Uskari chose Tavi to lead them, and Tavi has since doubled the trail patrols and still walks the worst stretch personally.

Relationships:

  • Hask: former chieftain
  • Skarra: friendly rival
  • Ketta: worried-over hunter
  • Sennu: uneasy ally on the trails
  • Rhys: old training partner

docs.title: Zirra
docs.text:
Bowyer

Role: Merchant · Age: Elder · Family: Uskari · Sells: Bows, arrows, climbing ropes and hunting knives

Precise, sardonic and impossible to flatter; Zirra judges people by how they hold a bow.

Zirra is the Old One's older sister and makes the bows the Uskari hunt and patrol with. She teases Hask mercilessly in private and defends Hask fiercely to anyone else.

Relationships:

  • Hask: younger brother
  • Ketta: former pupil

docs.title: Skarra
docs.text:
Captain of the Trail Watch

Role: Guard · Age: Adult · Family: Uskari

Stern, watchful and dryly funny once the patrol is safely home.

Skarra commands the Uskari patrols that guard the highland trails and see travelers from camp to camp. She marks every monster sighting on a hide map in her tent, and the marks have been creeping closer to town each season.

Relationships:

  • Tavi: friendly rival
  • Bekk: son

docs.title: Bekk
docs.text:
Trail Watch Scout

Role: Guard · Age: Young · Family: Uskari

Cocky, quick and kind to children, who follow him around in a small admiring crowd.

Bekk is Skarra's son and the fastest climber on the rim. He wants to prove himself by tracking a beast that has been raiding the high pastures, and his mother has forbidden him to try it alone.

Relationships:

  • Skarra: mother
  • Korrin: admirer

docs.title: Ketta
docs.text:
Returned Adventurer

Role: Adventurer · Age: Young · Family: Uskari

Bright and talkative about everything except one subject, which makes her go suddenly quiet.

Ketta left home to adventure across Veligor, like many young Uskari, and came back last spring with a new scar and a pack full of stories. She will happily tell any of them except what she saw in a deep canyon cave on her way home.

Relationships:

  • Zirra: teacher
  • Tavi: chieftain
  • Ennek: sweetheart

docs.title: Odda
docs.text:
Chieftain of the Brenna

Role: Ruler · Age: Elder · Family: Brenna

Warm, shrewd and endlessly calm; Odda can settle a quarrel between two chieftains with one well-chosen story.

Odda leads the Brenna, who host every choosing, and she hosted the one that named Hask after Old One Varra died. She keeps up an old friendship in Fairy Forest from her envoy days and still writes letters there each spring.

Relationships:

  • Thrun: husband
  • Lessa: daughter
  • Neffa: granddaughter
  • Ahvi: cousin
  • Hask: friend
  • Calyra: old friend

docs.title: Lessa
docs.text:
Bonesetter

Role: Healer · Age: Adult · Family: Brenna · Sells: Herbal salves, splints and highland remedies

Calm in a crisis and fussy everywhere else; Lessa will set a broken leg without blinking and then complain about the mud on your boots.

Lessa is Odda and Thrun's daughter and the best bonesetter in the highlands. She has treated more monster bites this year than in her first ten years of healing together, and she is running short of the highland herbs that grow only on the far slopes.

Relationships:

  • Odda: mother
  • Thrun: father
  • Neffa: daughter
  • Mabbu: grumbling patient

docs.title: Neffa
docs.text:
Song Learner

Role: Child · Age: Child · Family: Brenna

Solemn, serious and proud; Neffa practises the long songs under her breath all day long.

Neffa is Lessa's daughter and is learning the long song of the Old Ones from Ahvi. Her great wish is to recite the whole song at a gathering without a single mistake before she turns twelve.

Relationships:

  • Lessa: mother
  • Odda: grandmother
  • Ahvi: teacher

docs.title: Ahvi
docs.text:
Song-Keeper

Role: Scholar · Age: Elder · Family: Brenna

Soft-voiced, exact and gently stubborn; Ahvi corrects anyone who gets a chieftain's name wrong, however important they are.

Ahvi keeps the long songs that name every chieftain and Old One back to the Age of Division, and was the sister of the late Old One Varra. Lately she has been troubled by an old verse about beasts growing wild before the Burning came, and she cannot decide whether to sing it at the next gathering.

Relationships:

  • Neffa: pupil
  • Odda: cousin
  • Imre: friend

docs.title: Harra
docs.text:
Wool and Cheese Seller

Role: Merchant · Age: Adult · Family: Tolmach · Sells: Wool, hides, goat cheese and travel rations

Shrewd, cheerful and loud enough to be heard across the Trading Post; Harra never lets a customer leave without a taste of cheese.

Harra brings the Tolmach herds' wool, hides and cheese to market and drives a famously hard bargain with lowland traders. She worries that fewer traders make the climb each year now that the canyon roads are dangerous.

Relationships:

  • Mabbu: mother
  • Sennu: sister
  • Yarrek: husband
  • Kesh: son
  • Corwell: friendly rival trader

docs.title: Ennek
docs.text:
Canyon Guide

Role: Service · Age: Young · Family: Tolmach

Easygoing and confident, with a herder's eye for weather and a habit of whistling on dangerous ledges.

Ennek is Sennu's son and leads traders and travelers up the old Tolmach paths, as his family has since the founding. A spring on the south path that has run for as long as anyone remembers has gone dry this summer, and Ennek has not yet told his mother.

Relationships:

  • Sennu: mother
  • Kesh: cousin
  • Ketta: sweetheart
  • Corwell: employer

docs.title: Corwell
docs.text:
Keeper of the Trading Post

Role: Merchant · Age: Adult · Family: none · Sells: Lowland goods, lamp oil, salt, tools and travel supplies

Talkative, round and comfortable, with a lowlander's love of a good chair and a highlander's love of a good bargain.

Corwell came up the canyon with a trade caravan twenty years ago, was given water and a place by a Tolmach fire, and never went home. He runs the Trading Post where lowland goods meet highland ones, and he quietly worries about the caravans that now arrive later and later, or not at all.

Relationships:

  • Harra: friendly rival trader
  • Ennek: guide for hire
  • Imre: lodger

docs.title: People of Selsior
docs.text: The 100 people of Selsior in the game's first release.

docs.title: Leaders
docs.text:
• Aveline, Queen of Wonder Kingdom
  • Rhys, Captain of the Royal Guard
